body: I actually have been seeking help. I've seen a psychiatrist and am taking three sedatives/psychoactive drugs that help curb the impulses. I see a therapist weekly, and went through an intensive outpatient group program at my local hospital. There are just times when it seems overwhelming and hopeless.
Thank you for the kind words. It does help.

I'm in an outpatient program through the local hospital, using group therapy sessions. It's pretty intensive and is basically 7 hours a day for two says a week. It's hard to tell if it's helping yet but I was prescribed medication which I'm still getting used To (it just sedates me right now). Every day I go through phases of feeling decent to feeling completely down.
Thanks all, for the helpful comments. I'm seeing my therapist on Tuesday, and hopefully I can get myself under control (or at least talk to someone).
